```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** User Interface Usability Test Suite

**Target System:** Virtual Assistant System

**Test Objective:** To ensure that the Virtual Assistant System is usable by users with no computer background.

**Test Scope:**
- Functional testing of user interface navigation and functionality.
- Non-functional testing of user interface response time.

**Test Cases:**

| Test Case ID | Test Case Title | Requirement ID | Test Case Type | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | User can navigate the system without errors | VIRTUA-2.5-18 | Positive | System is launched | None | Click on different navigation options | User can navigate to different sections of the system without encountering errors. |
| TC-002 | System provides clear and concise instructions | VIRTUA-2.5-19 | Positive | User is on the main screen | None | Hover over help icons | A pop-up window with clear and concise instructions appears. |
| TC-003 | Consultation request form is easy to fill out | VIRTUA-2.5-20 | Positive | User is on the consultation request form | None | Fill out the form with minimal and only relevant questions | The form is filled in within 5 minutes. |
| TC-004 | Installation guide is available | VIRTUA-2.6-1 | Positive | None | None | Open the installation guide | The installation guide is accessible and provides clear instructions. |
| TC-005 | User manual is available | VIRTUA-2.6-2 | Positive | None | None | Open the user manual | The user manual is accessible and provides clear instructions on how to use the system. |

```
